name: Lonesome
source:
Lonesome is the story of a young and lonely boy who always wanted to be a mountaineer. But his father who is a very rich and selfish businessman wants him to take over the business. So, his son wants to run away from home. What happens to him depends on the choices the player takes.

[From[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210170546/http://www.renai.us/game/lonesome.shtml] Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
《孤独》讲述了一个年轻而孤独的男孩一直想成为一名登山运动员的故事。但他的父亲是一位非常富有且自私的商人，希望他接管生意。于是，他的儿子想要离家出走。他会发生什么取决于玩家的选择。

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210170546/http://www.renai.us/game/lonesome.shtml]仁爱档案[/url]]
